name: Shoot For Eggs
desc:
🥚 Welcome to Shoot For Eggs!

How to Play:
🔫 Shoot eggs across the map to crack them open
🐣 Hatch them into animals and place them on your plot
💰 Collect cash from every animal you own
🎯 Train on your DamageAuto pad to grow your damage
⬆️ Upgrade your target and unlock bigger pads
🏆 Buy better guns  from the pistol all the way to the RPG
✨ Discover rarer eggs, animals, sizes, and mutations!
🔄 Rebirth to multiply everything and reach the locked guns

🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile, Console, and Tablet players

creator.name: Eggs are the coolest thing ever!
